summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated July 9, 2026, reporting preliminary Q2 2026 results: revenue of US$129.2 million from 28,674 gold equivalent ounces. The release also discloses the completion of a previously announced US$440 million acquisition of a gold stream on the Ravenswood mine, and repurchase of US$20 million of shares in the open market. This filing is a routine business update that includes operational results, a closed acquisition, and a share buyback. None of these items represent a new special situation; the acquisition was already completed and the buyback is an ordinary-course capital allocation action. There is no new transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or other special-situation event being announced.
